findings.title: Cross-origin redirect strips only three credential headers
postForm/putForm/patchForm send JSON labelled as form-urlencoded on the bounded path
Timeout during body read is not mapped to the SDK timeout error
makeRequest silently replaces the caller's AbortSignal
Bounded path returns a Headers instance where the axios path returns a plain object
Bounded adapter serialises undefined query params as the string "undefined"
Intermediate 3xx response bodies are never consumed or cancelled before the next hop
Fallback timeout timer is never cleared after a request completes
Error bodies are read unbounded when only maxRedirects is set
Redirect protocol-downgrade and hop controls skipped when only maxContentLength is set
